verdict.rationale: v0 does publish API docs and an SDK with code snippets (v0-docs-4, v0-gh-1, v0-gh-2), but there is no evidence of an interactive API reference (e.g., a browsable console with runnable/try-it examples) — only static documentation pages and GitHub code samples. missing for 10: an interactive API console, in-browser runnable examples, evidence of a Swagger/OpenAPI-style explorer.
